A.visual: 環狀行星與星辰城全景，鏡頭緩慢右移，片名浮現

B.visual: 阿澄在前景岩石上擦亮紫水晶，水晶閃出星芒

C.visual: 岩洞口，藍色小星星忽明忽暗；鏡頭右移，遠方星門逐一熄滅

D.visual: 推近阿澄，小星星飄到指尖輕碰

E.visual: 阿澄捧著星星沿岩脊前行；星門熄滅，星星縮回掌心

F.visual: 水晶宮殿，畫面逐漸變暗，阿澄坐下

G.visual: 星星飛起照亮岩壁星圖；鏡頭右移到對面浮島的星儀，中央空著

H.visual: 推近星儀，阿澄踮腳把星星送回；藍光迸發，金環轉動

I.visual: 藍光沿河道流動重新織成道路；星儀閃一下，畫面淡出

cues.en: Beneath a giant ringed planet

cues.zh: 有座漂浮在雲海上的星辰城。
cues.en: floats Star City, above a sea of clouds.

cues.zh: 小學徒阿澄每天沿著光河，
cues.en: Each day, little apprentice Cheng follows the glowing river,
polishing the purple crystals of the floating isles.
One day, at the mouth of a cave,

cues.zh: 撿到一顆藍色的小星星。
cues.en: he found a tiny blue star.
Its light flickered,

cues.zh: 遠方的星門也一座座熄滅。
cues.en: and far away, the star gates went dark one by one.
"Are you lost?"

cues.zh: 小星星輕輕碰了碰他的指尖。
cues.en: The little star gently touched his fingertip.
Cradling it, he crossed the waterfalls
and the crystal palace.
But at every gate,
it shrank back into his palm.
Until the river of light faded beneath his feet.
"Oh no…

cues.zh: 連我也不知道怎麼回去了。」
cues.en: now I'm lost too."
Then the star flew up

cues.zh: 照亮岩壁上的金色星圖。
cues.en: and lit the golden star map on the rock.
Across the way, at the heart of a great armillary,
one small place stood empty.
Cheng climbed the steps, stood on tiptoe,
and set it home.
The golden rings began to turn,

cues.zh: 藍光沿著雲海重新織成道路。
cues.en: and blue light wove the roads again across the clouds.
Ever since, when his work is done,
the armillary gives a little wink
and lights his way home.
